F1: The async `forEach` callbacks reject outside the surrounding `try/catch`, leaving calendar or video cleanup failures unhandled.
F2: The recurring cleanup callbacks are not awaited, so their deletes may be missing from `apiDeletes` when it is passed to `Promise.all`.
F3: The imports are eager, but this is only a performance concern and no required lazy-loading behavior is established.
F4: Missing tests are not a behavior defect.
